subtitles.content: Even the Germans could not have dreamed this up!
Their anti China obsession has gone mad!
they actually thought
cutting off the Hong Kong Police from M P five seconds
to place a stranglehold chokehold on the Hong Kong Police!
I have pondered this for three days and three nights,
and I still cannot fathom how one gun could do that!
So, after all that fuss from Germany,
they ended up giving that Chinese made submachine gun
a free certification boost!
That M P five was the go to weapon
for Hong Kong Police’s elite units.
Back then, when you mentioned
the Hong Kong Police’s Special Duties Unit
the Flying Tigers
their signature weapon was the M P five,
same for the Airport Security Unit
those elites were all kitted out with M P five seconds, too!
The M P five is great no doubt about it!
Its superb shooting accuracy,
gentle recoil, and ultra low failure rate
have long made it a classic benchmark
in global counter terrorism.
The Hong Kong Police used it for over forty years,
their entire training system and logistics
were all built around it.
Officers had built up muscle memory,
so there was no real need to switch models—
yet, the Germans went and shot themselves in the foot!
In twenty seventeen,
Heckler and Koch tweaked its export policy
and booted Hong Kong off its new gun supply list.
Then, by twenty nineteen,
they ramped up sanctions
cutting off even repair parts entirely.
Even with a valid export permit,
you could not get your hands on it
they just would not let you use
that democratic high end gear,
the M P five.
Let us see what reliable S M Gs you can even use!
Honestly, this whole playbook using tech monopolies
to wield a stranglehold,
exploiting info gaps, and selling at inflated prices
And that is not just in the firearms sector
many consumer goods fields have mastered this art to a T.
Take me, for instance,
staying up late each night chasing story ideas,
for the past two years, I have felt my energy lagging,
getting tired so easily, and having zero drive for anything.
So, I figured I would try some supplements.
I heard that among stars and tycoons in the West,
an anti aging N A D plus supplement is all the rage.
So, what is this N A D plus?
It is a substance our bodies make naturally,
but post twenty five, it starts to deplete
leading to less energy,
poorer sleep, gray hair, and so on.
much of which links to N A D plus loss.
But then I saw it cost thousands per month—
just could not bring myself to get it—
until I came across this platform,
UndoAge.
This nutrition brand did something I find totally badass—
they blew the lid clean off the supplement industry,
kinda like the Pang Donglai of wellness!
They went straight to top tier industry
factories and raw material suppliers,
slashing the price of that N A D plus supplement
from thousands down to just seventy five bucks a month.
Plus, within their UndoAge mini program,
dozens of their other supplements are all just like this!
Same quality, yet priced
at just twenty five percent of big name brands!
Take their fish oil,
for instance, ninety five percent high purity,
plus I F O S international certification!
Dining out for a month
runs you two hundred to three hundred bucks,
theirs is just sixty nine,
and feels no different from those pricey brands
I used to take.
And what is even wilder than the price
is that they dare to lay out all their costs
production, Q C, you name it publicly!
plus, each batch comes with a full third party test report,
and no celebrity endorsements!
They do not even list on major e commerce platforms
just a WeChat Mini Program
a brand that grew via word of mouth and repeat customers!
I myself have been taking an N A D plus supplement
for a while,
and I feel my daily fatigue has eased up quite a bit
plus, new hair has started popping up on my scalp!
Plus, I paired it with fish oil and magnesium L threonate.
Fish oil is super helpful for someone like me
who stares at a computer screen all day
my eyes do not get sore so easily anymore.
Plus, after taking Magnesium L Threonate,
not only am I more focused when writing scripts by day,
but at night, I can crash right away!
This trio costs just over two hundred yuan
a month less than what some big name brands charge!
So this time, I snagged some exclusive perks!
Click the pinned link in the comments
to snag a one hundred R M B coupon pack,
plus extra credit perks,
key in the code word at checkout and you get double points!
Points can be swapped for more coupons!
So, no paying for brand marketing or markups spend wisely,
and that sense of security is truly prized!
Now, back to the sanctioned Hong Kong Police
to say they were not in a bind would be untrue.
Guns well, even with no real combat,
they still need training,
and if they break, there are no parts for repairs.
that was a huge headache!
plus, ammo stocks were dwindling
so they had to find a replacement.
At first, the Hong Kong Police
habitually sourced goods from the Western market.
Their first pick was Switzerland’s M P X
its handling mirrors
the M P five,
which would save tons on re training costs.
But then, in twenty twenty, the U S stuck its foot in,
sanctions were slapped on,
and S I G Sauer’s U S branch refused to supply them again,
the Hong Kong Police had no choice!
Then, they eyed the Czech C Z Scorpion E V O three—
only for the European Union to stir up trouble,
sealing off that path with their arms
export ban to China.
After all that back and forth,
trying to hand money to the West,
they would not even take it!
So, since that is the case, no other choice—
forget about training costs,
let us launch a global public tender!
A host of mainstream Western S M Gs
were brought out for real world tests
accuracy, reliability, upkeep costs, and supply chain stability
were assessed one by one.
And so, the one that came out on top
was none other than the export model of China’s Q C Q
one hundred and seventy one,
the C S / L S seven submachine gun!
I handled this gun at Airshow China twenty twenty four
and man, that feel was top notch!
Old notions held that Chinese made guns
could not match Western ones in build quality—
but now, that is truly old news!
The C S L S seven submachine gun
has been deeply optimized for urban police scenarios.
The empty gun weighs just two point eight kilograms,
so holding it for long spells is a breeze,
plus, the grip design has been tailored for Asian hand sizes,
which aids in lengthy shifts on duty.
With the stock folded,
At forty nine centimeters long,
it is perfect for Hong Kong’s tight alleys,
buildings, and subways
super agile and nimble!
Plus, performance wise, it rivals the M P five in every way.
It sticks with the classic closed bolt design,
at one hundred meters,
most rounds land snugly within a palm sized area.
Its accuracy is quite stellar,
fire rate is eight hundred to nine hundred rounds per minute,
with scant muzzle climb when firing full auto.
plus, the nine millimeters rounds it fires
are fully compatible with
the Hong Kong Police’s current Parabellum ammo,
so no new supply chain needs to be set up.
Most importantly, the entire supply chain is
domestic parts can be restocked anytime,
so no more bowing to others whims!
This April, during the On ko
inter departmental counter terrorism drill,
the Counter Terrorism Response Unit
made its first public, live fire debut
wielding the C S slash L S seven.
On May sixth, the Hong Kong Police confirmed that
the C S slash L S seven
has been issued to its Counter Terrorism Response Unit.
Going forward, it will be rolled out to more tactical units,
like the Emergency Unit and Police Tactical Unit .
to join the ranks of the Hong Kong Police’s elite units.
In fact, that itself is the highest praise
for the performance of China made firearms.
So, the German logic is quite bizarre,
it seems they truly thought that sans M P five seconds,
the Hong Kong Police would be left with mere firewood sticks!
They meant to wield cutting off supplies as a cudgel,
but instead, it let that Chinese made submachine gun
earn some super prestigious, real world validation—
talk about shooting oneself in the foot!
Beyond Hong Kong,
many police bodies in Southeast Asia and the Middle East
have started to follow
the C S slash L S seven’s combat performance.
The high end police firearms market,
once monopolized by the West,
is now being breached, step by step, by Chinese made gear.
Now, it is all about whether solid performance
can shatter biases
and win global acclaim.
